sources.text: Past cache allocation is explicit; the sequence reserves end-state growth in place. Traffic remains exactly the declared read/write equations.
Synthetic C01 contract example, not a production hardware/model preset.

source.mappingBasis: Declared model/actual-call scope, not hardware counter data

assumptions: Single-device serial baseline, one explicitly declared prefill/decode step; no implicit batch multiplier.
Each leaf is counted once. Containers aggregate leaves without adding another cost.
Weights, state, graph/runtime/reserve are resident; unreferenced workspace/communication storage is conservatively resident.
Activation lifetimes follow producers/last uses; temporary scratch is live only during declared uses unless linked across nodes.
Quantization payload alignment precedes tightly packed auxiliary tensors. Storage aliases share an allocation; accesses are counted independently.
Roofline is per compute class and leaf; each class uses the whole leaf traffic as an explicit shared-traffic bound, never a mixed-precision denominator.
Measurement example:executed:decode:single; time kind=single, count=1; per-call equivalent 2 second.

Executed-work utilization uses declared physical executed operations and unique matching peak capability on each actual device. It is separate from model-useful MFU and is not a measured hardware counter.

Measurement example:executed:decode:single, input 8bec73b8cebb810c45e3e39a11759acc5ca36e5c9302468cf6942a37d549a0c1; time kind=single, count=1.
